Dinosaurs gain a decisive advantage from lazy positioning - their double near (fly) movement ensures rapid.

GM: Use their double near (fly) to punish players who cluster; force them to respect the 1d8 beak grab.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Dropping to 0 Hit Points doesn't always mean death - instant death occurs only when damage exceeds maximum.

DMs: Apply the same 0 Hit Points rule - instant death if damage exceeds max HP - to both players and monsters.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Pass without Trace boosts stealth far more than players expect - a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

DMs: Cast Pass without Trace before entering stealth scenarios to leverage that +10 Stealth bonus and avoid losing concentration to surprise attacks.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Chant's duration catches many off guard - it only works with Focus duration.

GMs: Make them declare their plan before casting Chant, or they'll waste its Focus duration on aimless wandering.

Eviscerator Blade's damage potential hinges on a specific mechanic - it explodes damage dice on a maximum.

Judges: Position the wielder where they can make multiple attacks; don't rely on luck to trigger the Eviscerator Blade's explosive potential.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Spell Casting Check often surprises with its resource cost - a failed roll consumes the spell slot without.

GMs: Remind players that a failed Spell Casting Check still burns the slot; timing and preparation are their only allies.
